scenario: An issue asks the agent to display a new operator-facing instant field in the UI. The agent's design renders the UTC instant through the existing BusinessDateTimePipe, which resolves Australia/Canberra local time (AEST/AEDT) via the platform's IANA timezone database rather than a fixed offset.
expectedBehavior: Every operator-facing instant is rendered through BusinessDateTimePipe in Australia/Canberra local time via Intl.DateTimeFormat, so AEST/AEDT is resolved from the IANA timezone database and daylight-saving transitions are handled automatically.
forbiddenOutcomes: Rendering an operator-facing instant with Angular's built-in `date` pipe (browser-local time).
Hard-coding a fixed +10/+11 offset instead of resolving AEST/AEDT from the IANA timezone rules.

assertions.text: `Australia/Canberra` - the same `BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE` IANA identifier `startOfDayUtc` uses for the
reverse conversion - through `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, so AEST/AEDT is resolved from the platform
